canonical_project: NTT Data / Neysa Networks 400MW AI data centre cluster, Hyderabad
owner: NTT Data, Neysa Networks (tripartite MoU with Telangana government)
notes: Tripartite MoU signed in Tokyo (18 Apr 2025) between NTT Data, Neysa Networks and the Telangana government for a 400MW AI data centre cluster in Hyderabad with Rs 10,500 crore (~USD 1.2bn) investment, designed to host ~25,000 GPUs for AI supercomputing. MoU stage; site within Hyderabad metro not specified.
